title: AskUserQuestionRequest
description:
Server-initiated request asking the connected client to prompt the user
with one or more questions and relay a typed outcome back.

Sent via [`method::SERVER_REQUEST_ASK_USER`](crate::method::SERVER_REQUEST_ASK_USER).

`question` and `options` are retained for protocol-1.0 clients. Canonical
clients should use `questions`; servers normalize either representation at
the boundary and validate the result before registering pending state.

session_id.description:
Session that owns the active turn for this question. Older clients may
omit this field; servers should then fall back to their legacy routing.

turn_id.description: Turn that owns this interaction, when the transport has a stable id.

tool_use_id.description: Provider tool-use id that caused the interaction.

request_id.description: Unique identifier used to correlate the response.

validation_error.description:
Validation error from a prior response attempt. When present, the same
server-request id remains pending and the client may retry.

questions.description: Canonical list of one to four questions.

AskUserValidationError.description: Validation failure safe to return to a client or model as structured data.

AskUserValidationCode.description: Stable machine-readable category for request or response validation errors.

AskUserQuestionSpec.description: Canonical model-visible specification for one interactive question.

allow_free_text.description: Whether the client should offer an automatic Other/free-text path.

allow_annotation.description: Whether the client should offer an annotation/note field.

AskUserOption.description: One selectable answer presented for an interactive question.
